common.contentType: text/plain; charset=UTF-8 (no HTML part, so markup in user input is shown as text: SR-05)
rules: User input never appears in a header: the subject uses only the configured conference name; the only header value derived from input is the participant's address in To, which has passed email validation (no whitespace or control characters).
Emails are sent only after the registration is stored (AR-05); a send failure is logged with the registration id only and does not change the response (D-11).
Field labels are English (D-18); option names and consent texts come from the stored registration.

emails.subject: Registration confirmation: {conferenceName}
bodyContains: every selected option name, listed under its category label (Workshops, Events, Meals, Other activities), or 'No options selected'

emails.to: every address in ORGANIZER_EMAILS, in one message
emails.subject: New registration: {conferenceName}
bodyContains: First name, Last name, Email, and Organization or Study institution, Study programme, Student ID, each as 'Label: value'
every selected option name under its category label
every consent given with the time given
bodyExcludes: database or system identifiers other than the registration ID

attachments.content: the stored JSON copy, byte for byte (registration-copy.schema.json)
